agent_report.reasoning: The proposal contains substantial same-color contamination in the crowded middle and lower CO2 trajectories. The native panel supports deletion of several detections whose visible pixels lie on neighboring curves rather than the claimed CO2 series, especially low-trajectory points assigned to CO2 303K, CO2 333K, and CO2 373K. The remaining extraction is still incomplete because many dense low-pressure and overlapping markers cannot be assigned uniquely from the supplied native pixels without risking fabricated edits.

series.label: CO2 273K
series.comment: Upper black square curve is visibly real, but the proposal is short at low pressure and several overlaps remain unresolved.

series.label: CO2 283K
series.comment: Most upper red hexagons are supported, but low-pressure coverage is incomplete.

series.label: CO2 293K
series.comment: Upper blue triangle-up curve is supported at moderate and high pressure, but many low-pressure markers are missing.

series.label: CO2 303K
series.comment: Deleted four detections visibly lying below the upper teal downward-triangle trajectory; dense overlap and low-pressure coverage remain incomplete.

series.label: CO2 313K
series.comment: Magenta left-triangle curve is mostly coherent but remains short of the expected marker inventory.

series.label: CO2 323K
series.comment: The olive right-triangle series is heavily contaminated by neighboring curves in the crowded region; native evidence does not justify broad reassignment.

series.label: CO2 333K
series.comment: Deleted four points visibly below or outside the intermediate dark-blue diamond trajectory; many crowded assignments remain uncertain.

series.label: CO2 343K
series.comment: Brown pentagon curve is coherent but short of the expected marker inventory.

series.label: CO2 353K
series.comment: Pink hexagon curve is mostly supported but several low-pressure markers are unresolved.

series.label: CO2 363K
series.comment: Green star curve is visibly present and the template-fit rows coincide with visible markers, but coverage remains incomplete.

series.label: CO2 373K
series.comment: Deleted eight detections visibly above the lowest dark-blue circle trajectory or on neighboring curves; extensive contamination and missing low-pressure markers remain.
